neet_che_u05_t00_1.working: Molarity is moles per litre of solution. Solution volume changes with temperature, so molarity changes. Molality, mole fraction and mass % are mass-based, so they do not change.

neet_che_u05_t00_3.working: Take 1 L of solution: mass = 1160 g. Solute = 2 x 180 = 360 g, so solvent = 800 g. m = 2/0.8 = 2.5 mol/kg.

neet_che_u05_t00_4.working: A is true because molality is mass-based and does not depend on temperature. R is true, since x1 + x2 = 1. R does not explain A.

neet_che_u05_t00_5.working: I: converting molarity to molality needs the mass of solution, so density is required; I is correct. II: ppm (mass basis) and mass % are mass/mass, so temperature-independent. Volume % and mass/volume % involve volume, so they change; II is intended correct.
